integrity: A mathematical proof and an independent exhaustive enumeration implementation are provided. No independent scientific audit or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The recurrence applies to finite trees. The polynomial-time bound counts exact integer-arithmetic operations rather than bit operations. It does not establish a lower complexity bound, real-rootedness, or polynomial-time enumeration of individual packings. Prior-art priority could change if an inaccessible or unindexed equivalently explicit recurrence exists. Finite tests complement, not replace, the induction proof.
title: A five-state exact edge-open-packing enumerator for every tree
